annotations.title: Poland compared with the world (BIS, OECD): central bank rates, house prices, credit cycle, Finwire Housecast

description: Use for Poland against other countries: central bank rates and the NBP rate rank, real house prices abroad, price to income or rent, credit gap, and whether Polish housing is overvalued (Finwire Housecast). Say that a forecast is a model estimate. Poland against other countries from the BIS (Bank for International Settlements) and the OECD. topic policy_rates: central bank policy rates of BIS economies, the place of the NBP rate (finwire_policy_rate_rank, 1 = highest rate) nominal and real (rate minus annual CPI inflation), median, rank history, real effective exchange rate of the zloty. topic house_prices: real and nominal annual change of residential property prices by country with the place of Poland, and price-to-income and price-to-rent ratios of Poland and the OECD average. topic credit_cycle: credit-to-GDP gap of Poland and the debt service ratio of the private non-financial sector (no household-only ratio for Poland). topic housecast: Finwire Housecast (finwire_housing_valuation_gap), the housing valuation gap of Poland and panel countries and the model forecast of real house prices 4 and 8 quarters ahead; a horizon below the accuracy gate has no numbers.

country.description: Country code (ISO 3166 alpha-2, euro area = XM) to show next to Poland in policy_rates and house_prices.
